evidence_boundary: Measured izzi repository records and portal review issues from 2026-08-13/14 only; provider spend bounded to three Seedance jobs (590 credits total).

sections.title: Source, claim, run, and revision ledgers

sources.reference: portal voice bank (29 Kokoro voices; zf_xiaoyi V29 KEEP #27)

findings.summary: Episode template locked at 8 segments / 57 s / 1080x1920@24 by the draft-9 KEEP (issue #28).
Canonical corpus is 79.0 s, bounding the series to 2-3 episodes (30 s canonical per episode).
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Episode 03 is a documented callback plus provider location, not new canonical material.
findings.next_verification: Re-measure at series scale; confirm episode 03 composition.

findings.summary: Provider resolution cap persists: requested 1080p returned 720x1280; requested 720p returned 496x864 (three jobs, 590 credits).
findings.next_verification: One bounded 5 s 1080p probe on a new key/tier if acquired.

findings.summary: Voice selection zf_xiaoyi (V29) KEEP (issue #27) from the 29-voice Kokoro bank; MeanVC2 remap ~1-2 min per 30 s window.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Custom accents (Asian-American, Southern) are outside the stock bank.
findings.next_verification: Reference recordings if custom accents are required.

findings.summary: PGS subtitle burn recorded NOT-BURNED (bitmap track, no local burn path); track referenced.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: No local PGS burn path exists.

findings.summary: WASM byte-parity for izzi-svg-text-overlay.h is not yet verified.
findings.next_verification: Byte-parity check against the emitted overlay header.

findings.summary: Episode masters 01-03 are rendered, verified, and published full-motion; awaiting G4; baseline_state NOT-PROMOTED.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: No baseline promotion without an explicit KEEP.
findings.next_verification: Portal KEEP on the episode-master reviews + decision mirror.

findings.summary: Portal payload grows with full-motion reviews (96 MiB cap, ~86 MiB used); needs per-series planning.
findings.next_verification: Budget model for the next vertical before its first full-motion publish.

runs.result: 57.0 s draft-1 attempted render published; REVISE issue #18

runs.procedure: Draft-2 rework per five findings (T4 fit-page, masks, OCR scroll, A/V state machine, tiling forensics)
Two-region OCR bullet text (lane_offset_y) + canonical audio state machine
Audio-only remux of byte-identical draft-8 video

revisions.reason: v2 synthesis added measured estimates, pilots, and orchestration
v3 walkthrough documented the complete vertical arc
v4 expands to cut-v1-level detail as an assess-outcomes record

coda_share.title: Share
coda_share.share_summary: The ai-time-to-die walkthrough produced a measured, zero-spend-by-default production plan: an 8-segment / 57 s episode template locked by the draft-9 KEEP (#28), episode masters 01-03 published full-motion and awaiting G4, a 79.0 s canonical corpus bounding the series to 2-3 episodes, zf_xiaoyi (V29) voice selection, two-region OCR bullet text, wild 50 % opacity masks, and the portal plan-vertical review class. Limits: the provider resolution cap persists, PGS subtitles are NOT-BURNED, and WASM byte-parity is unverified.

output_format: pdf

Produce ai-time-to-die episodes with the accepted draft-9 pipeline: 8 segments / 57 s / 1080x1920@24, canonical dialogue remapped to zf_xiaoyi via MeanVC2, izzi red-on-white 20 pt two-region bullet text, wild 50 % opacity masks, T5 as the HLT stand-in unless provider spend is authorized, shinkansen bed elsewhere, full-motion portal review, validator passing under the 96 MiB budget, estimated against the 79 s canonical corpus bound and the measured 3-5 min per-episode render time. Keep every claim inside the declared evidence boundary, preserve evidence states, and do not promote baselines without an explicit G4 KEEP.
